lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: ٱلْمُزَّمِّلُ is in the derivative form: المُزَّمِّل
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ز/م/ل   z–m–l to run fast while veering to 1 side, to limp; to ride behind another person, a companion; to hide, to wrap oneself. Of this root, المُزَّمِّل ʾal‐muzzammil occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
المُزَّمِّل ʾal‐muzzammil [an assimilated form of act. part. مُتَزَمِّل mutazammil] the wrapped‐up one

(73:1) يَاأَيُّهَا الْمُزَّمِّل ُyou [Prophet], enfolded in your cloak!; * الْمُزَّمِّلُname of Sura 73, Meccan sura, so‐named because of the reference in verse

1 to ‘the One Enfolded in his Cloak’, denoting the Prophet.
